impact_on_spec: Read-only deployment diagnostic; preserve frozen strategy, costs and PnL.
limitations: Cash-account funding diagnostic only; actual account type, restrictions, eligibility and broker approval remain unverified.

claim: Schwab describes most stock and ETF trades as settling on the next business day; weekends and market holidays do not count as business days.
impact_on_spec: Read-only deployment diagnostic; preserve frozen strategy, costs and PnL.
limitations: Assume initial cash is fully settled and each preceding trading day ends flat; this does not establish actual broker buying power.
